GP.label: 1N54xx class: 3 A / 200 V general-purpose Si, standard recovery
GP.basis: V_F 0.72 / 0.85 / 0.95 V typical at 0.1 / 1 / 3 A (1.2 V max at 3 A); C_J 30 pF at 4 V; trr about 2 us (not specified for standard recovery); I_R <= 5 uA at V_RRM; BV taken 1.3 V_RRM

FR.label: 3 A / 200 V fast-recovery Si class
FR.basis: V_F 0.78 / 0.95 / 1.10 V typical (1.3 V max at 3 A); C_J 30 pF at 4 V; trr 150-250 ns; I_R <= 5 uA at V_RRM

SB.label: 3 A / 200 V Schottky class
SB.basis: V_F 0.60 / 0.71 / 0.84 V typical (about 0.9 V max at 3 A); C_J 150 pF at 4 V; no stored charge (majority carriers); I_R tens of uA at V_RRM

SB100.label: 3 A / 100 V Schottky class (D3* / D4* of SBM only)
SB100.basis: V_F 0.45 / 0.55 / 0.66 V typical; C_J 250 pF at 4 V; no stored charge

stick.label: HV rectifier stick, 20 kV / 5 mA avalanche class, fast recovery
stick.basis: 20 junctions of the 1 kV class in series [IR]; V_F 17 V at 1 mA and 20 V at 5 mA (about 1 V a junction at rated current) with N 1.8 a junction; 30 pF a junction at 0 V (1.5 pF the stick) graded M 0.33; trr <= 100 ns (fast class); avalanche BV 1.2 V_RRM; leakage typ 25 nA at 7.5 kV (the ledger's basis), max 2 uA at 25 C / 5 uA at 100 C (sim/diode-stack-findings.md)

clamp.label: 66 avalanche (Zener) diodes of the 200 V / 5 W class in series
clamp.basis: per device: dynamic impedance 2.5 V / I (2.5 kOhm at 1 mA, 500 Ohm at 5 mA), 10 Ohm bulk, 60 pF at 0 V; I_R <= 0.5 uA at 0.76 V_Z (typ 10 nA); the string trimmed by whole parts so its voltage at the record's clamp peak current is the record's node peak

models.ND-deck: the record's deck as is: ND (n 0.005) and DZ
models.ND-ic: the record's ND, varicaps as the deck, run as the new runs are (the deck's maximum step, the output interpolated)
models.ND: the record's ND, varicaps split (a consistent -1 kV seed)
models.HV-fwd: sticks: the forward law only (no C_J, Tt, leakage); clamps: the avalanche law only
models.HV-noleak: sticks with C_J and Tt 100 ns, no leakage
models.HV-typ: sticks and clamps with typical leakage (25 nA / 10 nA)
models.HV-max: the datasheet maximum leakage at 25 C (2 uA / 0.5 uA)
models.HV-VF2: typical leakage, V_F x 2 (40 V at 5 mA a stick)
models.HV-body: typical leakage + 1 pF body capacitance a stick
models.HV-slow: typical leakage, a slow stick (Tt 3 us)
models.HV-Rs: typical leakage + a 22 kOhm surge resistor in series with each of D1-D4
